cues.text: Good morning!
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Good morning - can I help you?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, is this where we register for the Beyond 2000 Conference?
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Yes? What's your name and I'll get your conference bag.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Well ... I haven't actually registered yet. I was told I'd be able to register today, so I hope that's OK ... I've just arrived in Melbourne.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: That should be fine, if you're a student. I'll need to take your details though. So can I have your full name?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, sure. It's Melanie Mitchell.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Is that M I T C H E double L?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, that's right and that's Ms not Miss.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: OK, fair enough! And what's your address, Melanie?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I live in student accommodation at Sydney University. So my address there is Room 66. Women's College. Newtown.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: OK. And which Faculty are you studying in?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I'm in the Faculty of Education - I'm doing a Master's in Primary School Teaching.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Right, and may I see your student card because I need to verify that you're a current student?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, sure. Here it is. My number is ... 9 9 4 5 7 8 E D.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: OK - now do you want to attend all three days? The conference runs from Thursday to Saturday.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, I think so - if I can afford it. What does it cost?
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Well, you're eligible for a student discount - which makes it $15 for a day registration or $40 for the three days, though it is possible to register for half a day only.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I'll register for all three days. please.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Good ... now will you be requiring accommodation while you're here in Melbourne?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, I suppose I will. What's available?
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Well... we have several levels of accommodation. You can share a room with another student for $25 a night.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Urn.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Or you can have your own room but share the bathroom - I believe it's just down the corridor - that's $45.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Right.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Or you can have a single room with your own bathroom .
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I don't mind sharing a room ... On second thoughts, yes I do - I'll have my own room, but I'll share the bathroom.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Right ... Now the conference fee does not include meals though you do get tea and coffee in the breaks. Shall I put you down for lunch - that's an extra $10 a day and there's the conference dinner on Friday night which is $25 ... oh, and what about breakfast?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Hang on a minute ... it's all starting to sound rather expensive! I'll have the lunch but not the dinner or breakfast - if that's OK?
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Perfectly OK. Now ... a couple of other things - there are a number of special interest groups organised - they're known as SIG's and you're asked to nominate your preference. They'll take place on the Friday afternoon and Saturday morning but they're filling up quickly which is why you need to nominate now.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Right. What are the SIG's?
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Well, there are six altogether. Let's see, on Friday you have a choice between Computers in Education or Teaching Reading Skills...
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Urn...
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: ... or a session on Catering for the Gifted Child.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Oh they all sound interesting but technology in the classroom is really my area of interest rather than reading, so I'll go for that. I can probably read up on the gifted child topic myself.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Right ... And then the Saturday options are: a session on Cultural Differences; or there's Music in the Primary Curriculum or you could go to the one on Gender Issues in the Classroom.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Wow! Can I go to them all? They all sound fascinating.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: I'm afraid not.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Well, I am really interested in how bovs and girls behave differently, even when they are very young, so I'd better opt for the third session even though the Cultural Differences SIG is probably really interesting, too.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: Right!
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: ... and the Music option would be ...
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: And how would you like to pay? We accept most credit cards - or bank cheques but not personal cheques, I'm afraid. Been caught out too often before - and cash, of course. We never say 'No' to cash.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I'll have to put it on my card cause I don't have enough cash on me, right now.
cues.speaker: Student

cues.text: That's fine. Enjoy your time here with us in Melbourne...
cues.speaker: Woman
